_note: The news list plugin (and its en/zh translations) stored its FlexForm without <field index> keys (settingsstartingpoint instead of settings.startingpoint), so News read no settings and listed every news record in the installation. Same values, standard format.

set.pi_flexform:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8" standalone="yes" ?>
<T3FlexForms>
    <data>
        <sheet index="sDEF">
            <language index="lDEF">
                <field index="settings.startingpoint"><value index="vDEF">44</value></field>
                <field index="settings.orderBy"><value index="vDEF">datetime</value></field>
                <field index="settings.orderDirection"><value index="vDEF">desc</value></field>
                <field index="settings.recursive"><value index="vDEF">0</value></field>
            </language>
        </sheet>
        <sheet index="additional">
            <language index="lDEF">
                <field index="settings.detailPid"><value index="vDEF">42</value></field>
                <field index="settings.listPid"><value index="vDEF">43</value></field>
                <field index="settings.backPid"><value index="vDEF">43</value></field>
                <field index="settings.limit"><value index="vDEF">20</value></field>
                <field index="settings.list.paginate.itemsPerPage"><value index="vDEF">10</value></field>
                <field index="settings.disableOverrideDemand"><value index="vDEF">1</value></field>
            </language>
        </sheet>
    </data>
</T3FlexForms>
